title: Restore unassisted erectile function after a finite treatment

concept.text: Durably restore erections in chronic vasculogenic or post-prostatectomy ED after treatment has ended. Regenerative approaches have clinical signals, but reliable, durable recovery without erection aids remains unestablished. Proposed completion test: Regulatory approval for restoration of untreated function following a sham-controlled pivotal trial of at least 300 men: at least 50% achieve normal-range IIEF-EF scores and successful unassisted intercourse at 12 months, after at least three months without erection aids. Post-prostatectomy efficacy requires a separately powered analysis. Test set by: Proposed editorial completion test using validated sexual-function outcomes; FDA would decide an approval claim. EAU and SMSNA identify the need for better controlled evidence on restorative therapies. Sources given: [EAU erectile dysfunction guideline](https://uroweb.org/guidelines/sexual-and-reproductive-health/chapter/management-of-erectile-dysfunction) ; [SMSNA restorative-therapy position statement](https://academic.oup.com/smoa/article/9/3/100343/6956862).
